data.summary: Senior Business Analyst & Product Owner | 8.5+ Years | Cards, Fintech & Payments Specialist: Dynamic and result-oriented professional with 8.5 years of experience spanning Business Analysis, Product Management, and Scrum Master roles within high-stakes banking and payment ecosystems. I possess a proven track record in driving large-scale digital transformations, specializing in ISO 20022 (MX) and ISO 8583 (MT) migrations, AI/ML-driven fraud management, and core banking modernization.

responsibilities: Senior Business Analyst/Product Owner | Fraud Management Systems for Banks and Central Infra like UPI | BFSi ( Cards Processing and Payments )

1. Strategic Product Roadmap & Market Intelligence: Orchestrate the product vision for bank-grade fraud systems by conducting deep-market research and competitor analysis to define a high-impact development roadmap.

2. Requirements Engineering & User Stories: Spearhead the end-to-end requirements gathering, prioritization, and backlog-ready user stories with robust acceptance criteria for both new feature development and legacy system enhancements.

3. Protocol Mapping & Canonical Data Modeling: Lead technical field mapping for in-house payment gateways, successfully normalizing ISO 8583 (Cards) and ISO 20022 (UPI/RTP) transactions into a unified canonical format for downstream fraud engine consumption.

4. AI/ML & GenAI Innovation: Drive digital transformation by implementing AI/ML models for real-time fraud scoring and integrating Generative AI within Case Management modules to automate investigative narratives.

5. API & Technical Documentation: Define comprehensive API requirements and technical specifications, complemented by wireframe/mockup designs and detailed release notes for cross-functional stakeholders.

6. NFR & Compliance Management: Capture and validate critical Non-Functional Requirements (NFRs), ensuring the platform meets stringent security standards, regulatory compliance, and high-concurrency performance benchmarks.

7. Agile Orchestration & Leadership: Facilitate all Scrum ceremonies to streamline development and deployment via CI/CD pipelines while coaching the team on Agile principles and risk mitigation strategies.

8. Stakeholder & Risk Management: Serve as the primary liaison between business units and engineering teams, managing diverse stakeholder expectations and proactively identifying project risks in high-stakes environments.
9. Organizational level responsibilities: Drive SAFe Agile, PI Planning, ART sync meet, JIRA admin for all products.
Senior Business Analyst/Project Manager | Digital Banking Solution and Payments for EY | BFSi
1. Strategic Roadmap & Capacity Planning: Engineered long-term product roadmaps and conducted capacity planning to ensure resource optimization for complex core banking development cycles.

2. Stakeholder Orchestration & Requirements: Facilitated high-impact workshops and group meetings with diverse stakeholders to capture business needs, translating them into comprehensive BRD/FRD and User Stories with testable acceptance criteria.

3. ISO 20022 Digital Transformation: Led a critical digital transformation project migrating legacy SWIFT MT messaging to the MX (ISO 20022) standard, enhancing data richness and global interoperability for transactions.
4. Customer Master Data Management (MDM): Oversaw the implementation of robust MDM strategies to ensure a "single source of truth" for customer data across integrated banking modules.
5. Security & Payment Validation: Spearheaded the implementation of Confirmation of Payee (CoP) and verification protocols to mitigate fraud during pre-transaction initiation phases.

6. Agile Lifecycle Management: Facilitated all sprint ceremonies and coached cross-functional teams on Agile principles to streamline development, testing, UAT, and deployment through CI/CD pipelines.
7. API Strategy & Documentation: Defined technical API requirements and authored detailed documentation to support seamless integration between core banking modules and external ecosystems.

8. Performance Benchmarking & NFRs: Established Non-Functional Requirements (NFRs) and conducted rigorous benchmarking to ensure system scalability and performance under high-concurrency banking loads.
9. Release & Defect Management: Managed the end-to-end defect lifecycle and release orchestration, ensuring stable code transitions from development to Go-Live.
10. Governance & Compliance: Proactively managed project risks and ensured all banking solutions adhered to strict global financial regulations and compliance standards.
As a Business Analyst at Amazon as a Client, my role focused on scaling payment ecosystems and enhancing user experience for Amazon Pay:
1. Requirements Engineering & Stakeholder Engagement: Led seminars and cross-functional workshops to gather business requirements from global stakeholders for complex payment modules.
2. Amazon Pay Wallet Enhancement: Orchestrated feature enhancements for the Amazon Pay Wallet by translating high-level business needs into detailed user stories and testable acceptance criteria.

3. SEPA Direct Debit Implementation: Managed the end-to-end implementation of the SEPA Direct Debit project, expanding European payment capabilities and ensuring seamless account-to-account transfers.
4. Merchant Acquiring & Bill Payments: Spearheaded the development of Merchant Acquiring services and Bill Payment modules, improving transaction success rates and merchant onboarding flows.
5. Agile Product Delivery: Facilitated all sprint ceremonies to drive development, testing, and UAT, utilizing CI/CD pipelines for automated and efficient feature deployment.

6. Performance Benchmarking & NFRs: Developed critical Non-Functional Requirements (NFRs) and conducted performance benchmarking to ensure the payment system could handle high-concurrency peak traffic events.
7. Security & Regulatory Compliance: Ensured all payment features adhered to strict global financial security standards, including PCI-DSS and regional compliance mandates.
8. API Documentation & Management: Defined technical API requirements for internal and external payment integrations, maintaining high standards for documentation and developer experience.
As a Project Lead at First Data, my role involved overseeing the complete delivery lifecycle for mission-critical payment systems:

1. End-to-End Delivery Leadership: Directed the full development lifecycle for high-volume payment processing applications, ensuring seamless delivery for global banks, payment gateways, and vendor partners.

2. Card Association Compliance: Managed complex integration and mandate compliance for all major card networks, including Visa, Mastercard, Amex, and Discover, to ensure global transaction interoperability.

3. Legacy-to-XML Transformation: Led the development of an in-house conversion engine that utilized detailed field mapping to transform legacy ISO 8583 card messages into human-readable and system-agnostic XML formats.
4. Security & Data Protection: Spearheaded the implementation of advanced Encryption and Tokenization protocols to secure sensitive cardholder data and achieve PCI-DSS compliance.

5. Quality Assurance & Sandboxing: Oversaw the creation of comprehensive test cases and managed rigorous test execution within sandbox environments to simulate real-world high-concurrency payment scenarios.
6. Release Management & Go-Live: Orchestrated the final deployment and Go-Live phases, ensuring minimal downtime and high system reliability during the transition of critical payment infrastructure.
7. Technical Documentation: Defined API requirements and maintained detailed technical documentation to support internal teams and external bank integrations.
